Fatal fire in London tower block results in one death

A fire in a 17th-storey flat in a London tower block has resulted in one fatality. Two other individuals were transported to the hospital for treatment. Firefighters rescued a child from the blaze. Residents described the scene as 'pandemonium' as they evacuated the building. The cause of the fire is not specified in the coverage.
